summary: Bangladesh's parliament convenes Thursday amid ongoing security and governance concerns, as authorities investigate four murders in Rangpur with questions raised about police handling. Domestically, the nation faces agricultural supply chain pressures with widespread fertilizer shortages despite official assurances of adequate stocks, while industrial sectors like garment manufacturing confront mounting competition and costs. Regionally, devastating floods across Nepal have trapped hundreds of tourists including Bangladeshis, while Burma's human rights crisis draws international scrutiny and India faces UN criticism over treatment of minority populations. Meanwhile, tech and infrastructure developments show promise, with major businesses increasingly adopting solar power and 5G handsets gaining market traction among consumers.
